LanguageData.ReplaceMountainRoofToNormalRoof: Replace Mountain Roof To Normal Roof
LanguageData.AutoReplaceThickRoof: Automatically add a Build Roof area to mountain roof in enclosed rooms
LanguageData.ForceAddRoofArea: Also add the Build Roof area to the whole room, even parts without a roof
LanguageData.TooltipForceAddRoofArea: Only works when the option above is on. Roofs are never added where you placed a Remove Roof area.
LanguageData.AllowPocketMaps: Allow replacing roofs in special places (the void, the undercave)
LanguageData.TooltipAllowPocketMaps: Off by default: these places are meant to keep their special roofs. Turn on only if you really want to change them.
LanguageData.AllowModdedThickRoofs: Also replace mountain-style roofs added by other mods
LanguageData.TooltipAllowModdedThickRoofs: Off by default: only the normal mountain roof is replaced. Turn on if other mods add their own mountain roofs and you want to replace those too.
